texts: In the book, the vertical long-axis plane is the best for assessing the mitral valve during LVAD implantation: D.
It shows both leaflets along their length, so their motion, any prolapse and the jet of regurgitation can be judged: the tall vertical frame.
The mitral valve matters because significant stenosis must be corrected before the pump starts, while functional regurgitation usually improves once the ventricle is unloaded.
Memory hook: a tall frame for the mitre.
